closeout.summary: Card 009 Edit now includes the canonical customer ID as a fixed ID label with an editable value, without displacing STATUS or changing Face 1.

editResults.result: Enabled businessIdentifier in Card 009's Face 1 edit runtime and raised its field allowance from six to seven. Edit now presents ID, YEAR, MAKE, MODEL, SERIAL #, HOURS, and STATUS; the ID caption is fixed while the canonical customer number remains editable and persisted.

tests: 11 focused Card 009 contract tests passed; 0 failed
PR #142 verified as exactly two changed files and merged

closeout.before: Card 009 Edit displayed YEAR, MAKE, MODEL, SERIAL #, HOURS, and STATUS but omitted the object's customer ID because includeBusinessIdentifier defaulted to false.
closeout.after: Card 009 Edit includes the fixed ID label and editable canonical customer number in addition to all six existing rows. Face 1 and the rest of Card 009 remain unchanged.
notes: Only the Card 009 runtime opt-in and its focused regression test changed.
The shared runtime, all other AOS cards, Card 009 display geometry, media, relationships, commands, and rail are unchanged.
